SELECT * FROM( select vfp.finprod_id finprodId, vfp.finprod_market_id bondid, vfp.finprod_abbr finprodAbbr, vfp.finprod_name finprodName, vfp.issue_price price, (vfp.issue_amt)/100000000 sumprice, vfp.ccy ccy, fpt.type_1 bondtype, fpt.type_1 bondtypeCode, vfp.bln_area blnArea, vfp.trade_market tradingplace, mci.CALENDAR_ID tradingtime, vfp.Issuer issuer, DATE_FORMAT(vfp.vdate,'%Y-%m-%d') vdate1, DATE_FORMAT(vfp.mdate,'%Y-%m-%d') mdate1, vfp.is_sus isSus, vfp.is_right isRight, vfp.exe_date exeDate ,
vfp.coupon_species couponType, vfp.coupon_species couponTypeCode, vccr.basis basis, vccr.calc_type ratetype, (vccr.yield)*100 ratestr,
vcpr.END_TDAY_RULE endTdayRule, vcpr.PAY_TDAY_RULE payTdayRule, vcpr.pay_cycle paycycle, vcpr.calc_rule calcrule,
(case when vcpr.calc_rule = '03' then DATE_FORMAT(vcpr.first_pay_date,'%Y-%m-%d') else '' end) fpayDate from FIN_PRODUCT vfp
left join FIN_CASH_INFO fci on vfp.finprod_id = fci.finprod_id
left join SELECT R.CASH_ID,R.FINPROD_ID,R.FINPROD_TYPE,R.EFF_DATE,R.BASIS,R.CALC_TYPE,R.YIELD,
if(@CASH_ID=R.CASH_ID,@rank:=@rank+1,@rank:=1) as newResult FROM (select * from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE ORDER BY EFF_DATE ASC) R, (select @rownum:=0,@CASH_ID:=null,@rank:=0)b ) vccr on fci.CASH_ID = vccr.CASH_ID AND vccr.newResult =1
left join FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE vcpr on fci.cash_id = vcpr.cash_id left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on vfp.finprod_id = fpt.finprod_id left join MST_CALENDAR_INFO mci on mci.CALENDAR_ID = vfp.CALENDAR_ID where 1 = 1 and vfp.finprod_type = 'F01' and fci.cash_type_1 = '02' AND vfp.finprod_id = #{finprodId} ORDER BY vcpr.Eff_Date desc ) WHERE LIMIT=1

select fep.exercise_status xqstate, DATE_FORMAT(fep.vdate,'%Y-%m-%d') applydatestr, DATE_FORMAT(fep.mdate,'%Y-%m-%d') applydateend,
(case when fep.exercise_type = '01' then '赎回' when fep.exercise_type = '02' then '回售' end) xqmode, DATE_FORMAT(fep.EXERCISE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') exerciseDate, fep.exercise_price xqnetprice, fep.exercise_remark xqclause from fin_exercise_plan fep left join fin_product fp on fep.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id where fp.finprod_id =#{finprodId}
select DATE_FORMAT(fccr.eff_date,'%Y-%m-%d') efdate, (fccr.yield)*100 rate2 from fin_cash_calc_rule fccr left join fin_product fp on fccr.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id where fp.finprod_id = #{finprodId}

select DATE_FORMAT(fcp.vdate_term,'%Y-%m-%d') theorydatestr, DATE_FORMAT(fcp.mdate_term,'%Y-%m-%d') theorydateend, DATE_FORMAT(fcp.vdate,'%Y-%m-%d') actdatestr, DATE_FORMAT(fcp.mdate,'%Y-%m-%d') actdateend, DATE_FORMAT(fcp.pay_date,'%Y-%m-%d') plandate, fcp.INT_AMT planintamt from FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp left join FIN_CASH_INFO fci on fcp.cash_id = fci.cash_id left join fin_product fp on fcp.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id where fp.finprod_id = #{finprodId} and fci.cash_type_1 = '02' order by theorydatestr

select fp.vdate vdate1, DATE_FORMAT(fcp.mdate,'%Y-%m-%d') jsdateend, DATE_FORMAT(fcp.pay_date,'%Y-%m-%d') paydate,
fcp.prin_amt remoney from FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp left join FIN_CASH_INFO fci on fcp.cash_id = fci.cash_id left join fin_product fp on fcp.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id where fp.finprod_id = #{finprodId} and fci.cash_type_1 = '01' order by jsdateend

select DATE_FORMAT(fcp.vdate,'%Y-%m-%d') jsdatestr, DATE_FORMAT(fcp.mdate,'%Y-%m-%d') jsdateend, DATE_FORMAT(fcp.pay_date,'%Y-%m-%d') paydate, cast('' as char)*100 qjrate,
fcp.prin_amt remoney, fcp.int_prin_amt jxamt, (fcp.int_amt) yjint, fcp.cash_amt cashflow from fin_cash_plan fcp left join fin_product fp on fcp.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id where fp.finprod_id=#{finprodId} order by jsdatestr

UPDATE FIN_PRODUCT SET FINPROD_ABBR = #{finprodAbbr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, FINPROD_NAME = #{finprodName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ISSUE_PRICE = #{price,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ISSUE_AMT = #{sumprice,jdbcType=VARCHAR} * 100000000, CCY = #{ccy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, BLN_AREA = #{blnArea,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRADE_MARKET = #{tradingplace,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CALENDAR_ID = #{tradingtime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ISSUER = #{issuer,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, VDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{vdate1,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d'), MDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{mdate1,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d'), IS_SUS = #{isSus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, IS_RIGHT = #{isRight,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, EXE_DATE = #{exeDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
COUPON_SPECIES = #{couponType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATE_USER = #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE finprod_id = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

UPDATE FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE SET PAY_CYCLE = #{paycycle,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
END_TDAY_RULE = #{endTdayRule,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PAY_TDAY_RULE = #{payTdayRule,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CALC_RULE = #{calcrule,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, FIRST_PAY_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{fpayDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d'), UPDATE_USER = #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATE_TIME = #{updateTime,jdbcType=DATE} WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
